title: ClawLess runs AI agents inside your browser
description:
ClawLess runs AI agents inside your browser
​
ClawLess is a serverless browser runtime for Claw AI Agents powered by WebContainers and WASM. It runs agents in a fully isolated sandbox with no server and no host system access. Built for developers who want lightweight, policy driven agent execution in the browser.
​
https://github.com/open-gitagent/clawless
